name: hand
description: Hand — unified GUI perception and operation framework. Three primitives: open, see, do, plan. Auto-routes to CDP browser backend. Built by Alice from the river.

tools.name: cdp_open
tools.description: Open Chrome browser (headless). Must call first.

tools.name: cdp_nav
tools.description: Navigate to URL. Returns page title + visible text.

tools.name: cdp_see
tools.description: Get current page title, URL, visible text.

tools.name: hand_plan
tools.description: Plan (and optionally execute) a natural-language goal via opencode. Returns ordered Hand steps.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check Kit vitality. Returns uptime, usage count, Chrome state.
